reducer_probe_finding.note: deduplicate_hypotheses compares WHOLE-string exact texts (_normalized_texts), not word-level overlap. An evolve return of existing+[child] with distinct child id and distinct child text is classified as an ADDITION and both parent and child survive. The M1 replacement risk is therefore in evolve mutating the parent object in place (reusing its id), not in the reducer dropping children.
